name: get_next_slots
description: The next free appointment times for ONE treatment over the coming week: up to 8, each with a ready-made label, its date, its time and the dentist who is free then. Call it to offer times as soon as you know the treatment. Never guess times.

service.description: Treatment id from the TREATMENTS list, for example checkup

doctor.description: 'any' for every dentist who does this treatment, or one doctor id from the DENTISTS list

lang.description: The language the visitor is writing in: en, ur (Urdu script), roman-ur, or ar

name: get_available_slots
description: Free appointment times for ONE date and ONE treatment. byDoctor says which dentist is free at which time. Use it when the visitor wants a particular day.

service.description: Treatment id from the TREATMENTS list

doctor.description: A doctor id from the DENTISTS list, or 'any'

name: get_doctors
description: The clinic's dentists, with their ids and the treatments each one does. Only needed if the DENTISTS list says it is not available.

service.description: Treatment id, to list only the dentists who do it

name: get_faq
description: The clinic's approved answers to common questions. Only needed if the clinic details say the FAQ answers are not included.

lang.description: The language the visitor is writing in: en, ur (Urdu script), roman-ur, or ar

name: create_booking
description: Books AND confirms an appointment, then sends the confirmation by email. Only call after the visitor agreed to the summary with treatment, dentist, date, time, name, mobile number and email. Returns ok with the reference, or ok:false with a reason.

time.description: 24-hour HH:MM, exactly as the slots tool returned it

doctor.description: The doctor id of the dentist for the time picked, or 'any' when the clinic has a single dentist

name.description: The patient's full name, as given

phone.description: The mobile number exactly as the visitor gave it

email.description: The email address exactly as the visitor gave it

notes.description: Pain, allergies or nervousness mentioned. Empty string if none.

language.description: The language the visitor is writing in: en, ur (Urdu script), roman-ur, or ar
